title: Forge Agent Bounty: initialise the bounty marketplace
summary: Initialise the marketplace, create an SPL-escrowed bounty, claim it, submit completion, and approve so the agent is paid 95%.
what: Forge Agent Bounty is an Anchor 0.30 program for an agent bounty board with SPL escrow. This lesson covers initialize, which writes a marketplace PDA. Later instructions create, claim and review bounties; those need a mint and were not exercised. The hosted IDL is a hand-derived initialize-only subset confirmed on-chain.
app_note: The page at /dapps/forge-agent-bounty/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console, with this devnet program id filled in.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/forge-agent-bounty/, switch to Devnet, and connect a wallet. initialize is already done.
A second initialize should fail because the marketplace PDA already exists.
try_steps.see: account already in use / simulation failure.
try_steps.ran: A second initialize was rejected in tests/devnet/forge-agent-bounty.mjs.

instructions: create_bounty, claim_bounty, submit_completion, approve_completion, reject_completion exist in the program but are not in this IDL
innovation: An on-chain bounty board for agents with SPL escrow.
exercises: Sketch the SPL escrow create_bounty would open.
not_covered: reject_completion was not exercised. The 5% platform fee stays in the escrow account.
build: Anchor 0.30.1 program at 782W4V1wdFrioJhmU2zQmPpj9MrJ3hfkwifQsRE6oeUu on devnet. IDL hand-derived subset, tx-confirmed.
student_outcome: Initialise or inspect the bounty marketplace config and explain what initialize does not prove about SPL escrow payouts.

learning_loop.objective: Inspect bounty marketplace initialise — then separate config from escrowed payout claims.
learning_loop.predict_question: Initialize succeeds for the Forge Agent Bounty marketplace. What have you proven?

predict_options.label: That SPL bounty escrow payouts already completed end-to-end
That marketplace config/init works — escrowed bounty lifecycle still needs separate evidence
Only that the React page loaded

learning_loop.predict_why: Initialize sets marketplace configuration. Escrowed bounty create/claim/payout paths are separate demonstrations even if the IDL lists them.
learning_loop.act: Open /dapps/forge-agent-bounty/ on Devnet. Initialise or fetch the marketplace config from lab proofs. Note SPL mint/escrow fields if present, and list bounty flows you are not claiming.
learning_loop.explain_question: Why can initialize succeed while a later bounty payout still fail?
learning_loop.transfer: Name one config field you would check before posting a bounty, and one payout claim you refuse without escrow evidence.
